subject: Horizon: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory for SIG review
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@horizoncap.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@horizoncap.com
Date: 2028-03-29 09:12 -0700
Subject: SIG request: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory

Hi Marissa,

Security team at Horizon is working through the SIG and has a couple of follow-ups specifically around encryption and key management. Can you provide the following artifacts for our review by next Thursday (4/4)?

- Key ceremony notes for your HSMs (high level chronology + roles present; redacted if needed)
- Sample rotation log showing a tenant key rotation event (sanitized)
- A list of TLS cipher suites and protocol versions we actively support on your public endpoints
- Short mapping of operator roles vs. privileges for HSM access (names not required; titles/roles ok)

If any of these items are sensitive, we can accept sanitized excerpts or a summary attestation. Also let us know your preferred secure transfer method (S3 presigned, encrypted zip, etc.).

Thanks — appreciate a quick ack and ETA.

— Liam
Security Engineering, Horizon Capital
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@horizoncap.com>
Date: 2028-03-29 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory

Liam — thanks for the clear list. Acknowledged. I will coordinate with our infra and cryptography teams and assemble a package. Planned deliverables:

- attestation_summary.pdf (high-level HSM ceremony summary + redaction notes)
- key_ceremony_notes.txt (sanitized chronology and roles)
- rotation_sample.csv (sanitized rotation log for a tenant key)
- cipher_list.txt (OpenSSL-style ciphers output for public endpoints)
- operator_matrix.csv (role -> privilege summary)

Preferred transfer: we can provide a time-limited S3 presigned bundle or encrypted zip (PGP). I'll include both options in the delivery email.

I'll loop in Irene Choi (infra/compliance) and Karthik Iyer (crypto ops) to own artifact collection. Targeting delivery by end-of-day 2028-04-01; if anything needs to be faster pls flag.

Regards,
Marissa
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-29 11:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG request: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory

Team — forwarding Horizon's SIG asks (below). Action items:

1) Karthik: can you prepare the sanitized rotation CSV + key ceremony notes? Include date/time, key id (sanitized), action (rotation/import), and operator role (no PII).
2) Irene: please extract the cipher inventory for endpoints (public API, control plane) and confirm TLS versions/cipher families. Also prepare operator_matrix.csv (role -> allowed HSM actions).

We should aim to produce the attestation_summary.pdf that describes what we are sharing and any redactions. If either of you foresee compliance concerns with sharing raw logs, propose a sanitized alternative.

Target delivery: 2028-04-01 EOD. If you need more time, tell me before EOD today.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-29 13:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory

Thanks Marissa — quick status update:

- Cipher inventory: I can produce an OpenSSL cipher list extract for our public endpoints and a summary table showing TLS versions supported (TLS1.2/TLS1.3 only). Will flag any deprecated ciphers if present.
- Operator matrix: we have a RBAC export showing HSM operator roles (HSM Admin, Crypto Operator, Audit Read-only). I'll transform to the requested role->privilege CSV and redact specific usernames.
- Raw operator logs: those contain user identifiers and audit traces; compliance prefers not to share raw full logs. Proposed: include a redacted excerpt (timestamps + action + redacted operator id) and a checksum/manifest proving the excerpt came from the full log.

Storage notes: artifacts will live in a secured S3 path in our compliance bucket. I will coordinate presigned link creation for Horizon.

I have one question for Horizon: do you require HSM vendor attestation (full vendor-signed report) or is a Redwood-generated attestation sufficient for SIG purposes?

Irene
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-29 15:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory

I'll take the key ceremony and rotation artifacts. Planned files and contents:

- key_ceremony_notes.txt — sanitized chronology with ceremony date, key purpose (tenant encryption), and operator role titles (no personal names).
- rotation_sample.csv — columns: event_time, key_id (redacted xxxxx), action (rotate/import), trigger (manual/auto), validation_hash.
- attestation_summary.pdf — short doc describing redaction approach, HSM vendor (Thales Luna SA-10 on dedicated cluster), and custody model (split-operator + YubiHSM for bootstrap).
- cipher_list.txt — output of `openssl ciphers -v` for our front-door and control-plane TLS stacks. My preliminary note: we support TLS1.2 (ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384) and TLS1.3 (CHACHA20-POLY1305, AES128-GCM-SHA256). Will include full dump.

Timeline: I can assemble sanitized rotation_sample and key ceremony notes today and hand to Irene for packaging; final package ready 2028-04-01 morning.

Karthik
Crypto Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@horizoncap.com>
Cc: procurement@horizoncap.com
Date: 2028-04-01 09:00 -0700
Subject: Delivery: HSM ceremony notes + TLS cipher inventory (SIG package)

Liam — delivering the requested SIG artifacts. Below is what we're providing and how to retrieve securely. If you prefer a short walkthrough, I'm available for a 30-minute call this week.

Included artifacts (attached as stubs here; presigned link for full package follows):
- attestation_summary.pdf (stub) — describes what is included and redactions
- key_ceremony_notes.txt (stub) — sanitized chronology and role titles
- rotation_sample.csv (stub) — redacted rotation event sample
- cipher_list.txt (stub) — OpenSSL-style cipher inventory and TLS version notes
- operator_matrix.csv (stub) — role -> privilege summary (no names)

Secure transfer options:
- Preferred: time-limited S3 presigned bundle (I will send the link in a separate email to the security address).
- Alternative: encrypted ZIP (PGP) — our PGP fingerprint: 3B2A 9F18 7C4E 9D12 4A3B E9F8 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0

Notes:
- HSM vendor: Thales Luna SA-10; our operations use split-operator ceremonies and hardware offline key wrapping for tenant master keys.
- TLS posture: Public endpoints present TLS1.2 and TLS1.3 only. No RC4/CBC-based ciphers in production. Full cipher dump attached.
- Redaction: rotation_sample.csv contains redacted key IDs (masked) and event timestamps; we have preserved validation hashes so you can verify the excerpt integrity.

Attachments: attestation_summary.pdf (stub), rotation_sample.csv (stub), cipher_list.txt (stub), key_ceremony_notes.txt (stub), operator_matrix.csv (stub)

If Horizon wants vendor-signed HSM attestation, we can request an official Luna attestation package (vendor may require an NDA and ~2 week lead time). Let me know if that is necessary.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
